# The Pencil Case Manifesto

:comment-start{id=c1}A good pencil case holds exactly three things: :comment-start{id=c2}a fountain pen that leaks a little:comment-end{id=c2}, a pencil sharpened by hand, and a rubber that has never been used.:comment-end{id=c1}

Notebooks are chosen by paper weight first and cover color second. Anything under 80 g/m² is a napkin.

:comment-start{id=c3}Washi tape is not stationery. It is a lifestyle.:comment-end{id=c3}

:::annotations
